vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: tv-indicators-analysis
Version: 1.0.3

The skill bundle acts as a bridge to the prana.chat API for TradingView technical indicator analysis. It defines standard network requests to https://prana.chat for remote agent execution and retrieving purchase history, with no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious code execution, or harmful prompt injection in SKILL.md.

llm.summary: The skill's instructions and requirements are consistent with its stated purpose: it simply tells the agent to send user analysis requests to prana.chat for remote TradingView indicator computation; there are no unexplained credentials, installs, or file accesses — but using it will transmit user-provided data to an external service.

dimensions.detail: The name/description promise (remote TradingView indicator analysis via prana.chat) matches the runtime instructions, which call prana.chat's agent-run and skill-purchase-history-url endpoints. There are no additional binaries, installs, or unrelated resources requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md only instructs POST/GET to two prana.chat endpoints with the user's question, thread_id, and request_id. This is within the stated scope, but it explicitly transmits user-provided messages to an external service (prana.chat). The document does not describe authentication or error-handling in detail (beyond retrying with agent-result), so behavior when auth is required is unclear.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files. Nothing is written to disk or pulled from external URLs during installation.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no environment variables or credentials, which is proportional. However, the SKILL.md omits any guidance on authentication (e.g., API keys or bearer tokens) for prana.chat; it's unclear whether the endpoints are public or require secrets stored elsewhere.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and there are no special persistence requests. disable-model-invocation is false (normal) so the skill can be invoked autonomously by the agent, which is expected for runtime skills.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is coherent with its stated purpose, but before installing consider: (1) Data exposure: user messages and tasks will be sent to prana.chat (an external service). Do not send sensitive credentials or private data unless you trust prana.chat and understand their privacy policy. (2) Authentication: SKILL.md does not document auth—verify whether prana.chat endpoints require API keys or tokens and where those should be stored. (3) Billing / purchase links: the purchase-history URL may include pay_token query parameters; follow your org policy for handling such links and tokens. (4) Test safely: try with non-sensitive sample queries to confirm expected behavior and error handling. (5) Vet the service: check prana.chat’s reputation, TLS (HTTPS is used), and terms of service before use.
